intro: South Sudan is covered by savanna, swamps and the White Nile.

chapters.title: The Sudd
text: The Sudd is one of the largest wetlands in the world, a huge swamp on the White Nile. Each year one of the largest animal migrations on Earth, of antelopes like the white-eared kob, crosses the country.

chapters.title: Climate
text: A long rainy season brings floods, which have displaced many people in recent years.

keyTerms.meaning: Land covered by water for much of the year.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of South Sudan's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
